full_text:
The Organization's motorbikes are dark blue motorbikes used by the Organization.

History

The Organization sent four agents on motorbikes to ambush the Huntik Foundation Jet upon its arrival in Baja California. [The Power of Umbra]

• The design of the bikes resemble the early 2000s superbikes/sportsbikes.
